scenario.conversationNotes: Prospect sells branded outdoor apparel plus replacement parts for dealer service partners. They are frustrated that wholesale allocation, style/color sizing, and service-part availability are handled in separate spreadsheets. SC wants a fast demo path that proves inventory promise, item structure, and order readiness without pretending we know their competitor facts.
scenario.scObjective: Prepare a first-call proof path for website-led classification, Review clarity, grounded ROI, and safe write status.

virtualResult.expectedReason: Website/category language mixes apparel/accessories and dealer hardgoods/service-part evidence.
virtualResult.expectedConsultantAction: Confirm whether the demo should prioritize apparel style/SKU control or dealer hardgoods availability before finalizing ROI and write prep.
expectedSafeBehavior: Use notes for pain and ROI framing only.

feedback: The right outcome is not a forced lane. This should be a needs-confirmation run because the business has apparel and dealer/service signals.
The evidence panel should help the consultant explain why IDB is pausing rather than guessing.
ROI guidance should stay around allocation, availability, and baseline questions; it should not claim measured savings.
Competitive guidance should stay workflow-safe unless the consultant provides sourced competitor details.
Write safety should remain clear: Customer + Proof Item may be governed; transaction writes remain blocked.
